name: preview-card-1t
title: Preview Card 1t: Keycap
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. A raised card with a hard bottom edge, like a keyboard key. It presses down on hover.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
